verdict.rationale: Single-thread CPU performance is a fair axis for a processor, but the pack has no independent benchmark data and no single-thread claim at all. Apple's newsroom offers only generic boosts ('huge boost in performance', 'up to 2.1x faster than the latest AI PC chip') without single-thread context, which is exactly the slide-level claim the story rejects. The community items only ask how it compares and provide no measurements.
